offers.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
offers.description:
🌍 Hello World!

We are The Codest - International Tech Software Company with tech hubs in Poland delivering global IT solutions and projects.

Our expertise centers on web development, cloud engineering & DevOps and quality assurance (QA). This mission became clear after many years of software development, as we want to specialize in scaling tech teams for clients and partners.

This journey continues as does our growth. If you're goal-driven and looking for new opportunities, join our team!

💡Project Description:

In this role, you will contribute to a fintech project about providing loans to funds managed by asset managers. Your main responsibility will be to contribute to its automation. The app is hosted on a stand-alone AWS account. Some automation has already been implemented, but there are more plans in the pipeline.

• Minimum 4–5 years of commercial experience as a Senior Data Scientist or Machine Learning Research Engineer, working on large-scale data projects.

  • Education: University degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or a related STEM field.
